description: Implementation of the AddressList class managing IP endpoint addresses, aliases, and related operations within the net namespace.

classes.name: AddressList
classes.description: A class representing a list of IP addresses and associated DNS aliases, with methods for creation, manipulation, and logging.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddress
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from a single IPAddress and port.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddressList
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from a list of IPAddresses and DNS aliases.

methods.name: CreateFromAddrinfo
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from addrinfo struct linked list.

methods.name: CopyWithPort
methods.description: Returns a copy of an AddressList with all addresses set to a specified port.

methods.name: SetDefaultCanonicalName
methods.description: Sets the canonical name to the string representation of the first address.

methods.name: SetDnsAliases
methods.description: Sets the DNS aliases for the AddressList, handling empty string case.

methods.name: AppendDnsAliases
methods.description: Appends additional DNS aliases to the existing list.

methods.name: NetLogParams
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of parameters for logging, including address list and aliases.

methods.name: Deduplicate
methods.description: Removes duplicate addresses from the list.
